name: Trek PDF
author: iscodeminister
description: PDF trip report with OpenFreeMap route maps, day-by-day itinerary, accommodation and costs, in your TREK language

settings.label: Map background
settings.hint: Draw a map (OpenFreeMap or OpenStreetMap, as picked in the tab) under the report maps. The server fetches tiles from tiles.openfreemap.org or tile.openstreetmap.org; turn off to keep every map fully offline (routes and markers only).

settings.label: Default map style
settings.hint: The style the Report tab starts with; each user can still pick another one in the tab.
